facts.fact: The BCEAO page states that structures are authorised as payment institutions in the UMOA under Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services, which applies to Cote d'Ivoire as a member.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services

facts.fact: The BCEAO page states that nine payment institutions were licensed in Cote d'Ivoire at 28 February 2026, out of 31 in the Union.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services
